answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while equivocation proofs link signatures and expose coordination. For k correlated identities, penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), making attempts to forge conflicting histories rapidly uneconomic. Upon detection, controlling the swarm triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery; even an ocean of aliases cannot shield a core stake, while honest nodes remain an oasis of lower risk.
